name: Reese Greenwood
abstract_title: Nested Fractal Reality Framework: A Step Towards A Unifying Consciousness Theory
abstract: Nested Fractal Reality Framework (NFRF) proposes that reality is composed of hierarchically nested systems whose interactions give rise to qualitatively new domains of existence. As systems increase in complexity and their interactions cross threshold conditions, they generate emergent structures with novel capacities—for example, physics giving rise to chemistry, chemistry to biology, and biology to technology.
